sample_unit: LLM responses (30 queries x 3 models x 2 runs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM STI responses (FKGL, FRE, GFI, SMOG) across three models
links.effect: GPT-5.4 was the least readable on all four metrics (all adjusted P < 0.01); the other two models were more readable. Absolute grade levels are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: GPT-5.4 produced the least readable text on all four metrics (all adjusted P < 0.01).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs answering patient STI queries using expert clinical evaluation and readability metrics, with no specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice tested.
